name: Harlot
overview: The Bible presents the harlot as a figure involved in deceit and danger, exemplified by Rahab who hid Israelite spies despite her profession, demonstrating God's use of even unlikely individuals in His plans (Joshua 2:3-6). The seductive speech of a strange woman is described as sweet yet ultimately leading to bitter consequences, warning believers to shun such shamelessness and avoid their machinations (Proverbs 5:3-4). This topic also includes instructions about not accepting the hire of a harlot in the temple, emphasizing the call for holiness and separation from sin.
